title: sparkxray ingest manifest
description: One Spark application's event log after ingest: where it came from, which files were read, and how far the log can be trusted. The tables manifest holds it under ingest.

source.description: The location ingested, as a file://, s3:// or http(s):// URI. A server's is the REST API address of the application, or of its attempt.

app_id.description: The App ID SparkListenerApplicationStart carries, or the one the log's name holds when that event is missing.

layout.description: rest_rebuild: a server answered with no event log, so sparkxray rebuilt one file of listener events from its REST JSON.

files.description: The log's files in read order. A rolling log's files are ordered by N as an integer.

etag.description: The S3 object's ETag; null for a local file.

mtime_ns.description: A local file's modification time in nanoseconds since the epoch; null for an S3 object.

codec.description: The codec the file was written in.

read_path.description: The local file holding this file's events: the file itself, the downloaded object, or a copy of its whole lines in the cache.

read_codec.description: The codec read_path is compressed with.

compacted.description: A History Server compacted the rolling log, which drops finished tasks.

in_progress.description: Spark had not finished writing the log, by its .inprogress name or its rolling appstatus marker.

truncated_tail.description: The log's last file ends partway through a line, a compressed block or a frame, and what followed its last whole line was dropped.
